verdict.rationale: A corporate card product could plausibly offer a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only rewards, partner perks and app-based withdrawals, and the probe for OpenAPI specs returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file is a guide index, not a programmatic API, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
